chapter: 15 Land of the Dead: the exit switch of the Xibalba entrance room does nothing while its key socket is empty (docs/matrix/15_land_of_the_dead.md C15-20, first half; C14-01)
note: KNOWN GAP (fails at switch_without_the_key: reveal 5464 reaches state 3). Since the switches are used through their use records (World::engagedUse) Interact here does use 5469 (before, the autopilot's stand point was out of the reach rule's range and the step passed without a use). The original locks it: its state code (type 13914 function 1; [I] run as the unit starts) without sticky +36 runs vt 61 -> modifiable 7 (2), the locked state 2 whose use is a failed try, until the key goes in (keyhole 6501 vt 20 with state 1 -> 5469 vt 62: sticky +36, vt 60 -> modifiable 7 (1)) [O bytecode]. Ours honours modifiable 7 on switches for ar_ei_switch_oneway only (docs/formats/ANIMGRAPH.md); honouring it here also needs the key to reach this unit (ch15_ballcourt_exit_key). l4_ballcourt, the room under the ball court with the spike pit, from its checkpoint 6122. Wall switch ca_ei_switch_wall_autoreset 5469 opens the temple reveal 5464 (anim graph 0 -> 3 -> 5 -> 6 -> 7, ProgressionReal.TempleRevealReopens) only once key 5695 sits in socket 6501 (the socket's sticky, set by the insert). Here Lara comes without the key, as on the way in (C14-01) and as a Land of the Dead player who left the key behind: Interact at the switch changes nothing. The second half (the key set in, the switch pulled, the exit open) is tests/selftests/known_gaps/ch15_ballcourt_exit_key.json.
